title: Grade 4 CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — Premium Revision Paper #7

pages.quiz:
CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — PREMIUM REVISION PAPER #7
====

GRADE: Grade 4
SUBJECT: CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
TIME ALLOWED: 120 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 100
ASSESSMENT: CBC school-based practice paper

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show your working and write the units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the one best answer.
4. Check your work before you hand in.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which Bible passage says that we are fearfully and wonderfully made? (1 mark)
   A. Matthew 6
   B. Numbers 22
   C. Acts 2
   D. Psalm 139

2. Why is knowing your full name important for your safety? (1 mark)
   A. You can hide it from your parents
   B. You can use it to tease others
   C. You can tell a helper who you are if you get lost
   D. You can forget your family

3. Which thought is likely to lead to a wrong action? (1 mark)
   A. I want to take what is not mine
   B. I will share my lunch
   C. I will help my friend
   D. I will thank my teacher

4. Who said, "As for me and my household, we will serve the Lord"? (1 mark)
   A. Peter
   B. Abraham
   C. Stephen
   D. Joshua

5. What should you do if you make a wrong choice? (1 mark)
   A. Blame others
   B. Hide it
   C. Admit it, say sorry and try to put it right
   D. Repeat it

6. What brings harmony in a family? (1 mark)
   A. Jealousy
   B. Fighting
   C. Selfishness
   D. Respect and love among members

7. Which action shows reverence for God? (1 mark)
   A. Talking during prayer
   B. Throwing the Bible
   C. Handling the Bible with care
   D. Laughing in church

8. How many books are in the whole Bible? (1 mark)
   A. 66
   B. 39
   C. 27
   D. 100

9. Which of these is a sign of real repentance? (1 mark)
   A. Making things right with those we wronged
   B. Only saying sorry with words
   C. Repeating the wrong
   D. Hiding the wrong

10. What does it mean to repent? (1 mark)
   A. To be sorry for sin and turn away from it
   B. To run away
   C. To blame others
   D. To pretend nothing happened

11. What does it mean to fear God? (1 mark)
   A. To run from Him
   B. To ignore Him
   C. To respect and love Him and obey Him
   D. To be terrified of Him

12. What did the seven thin cows stand for? (1 mark)
   A. Seven years of plenty
   B. Seven years of famine
   C. Seven towns
   D. Seven servants

13. Which of these shows obedience like Abraham's? (1 mark)
   A. Ignoring instructions
   B. Arguing
   C. Following good instructions even when it is hard
   D. Waiting for others

14. Where did Abram live before going to Canaan? (1 mark)
   A. Rome
   B. Bethlehem
   C. Egypt
   D. Haran

15. In which town did Mary live? (1 mark)
   A. Bethlehem
   B. Nain
   C. Nazareth
   D. Jericho

16. What did John call people to do? (1 mark)
   A. Rest
   B. Fight
   C. Repent
   D. Trade

17. Which person is showing gratitude? (1 mark)
   A. A child who complains
   B. A child who laughs
   C. A child who thanks her neighbour for a kind act
   D. A child who forgets to thank

18. What happened after Jesus spoke? (1 mark)
   A. The dead man sat up and began to talk
   B. He ran away
   C. The crowd left
   D. Nothing

19. According to the Lord's Prayer, we ask God to forgive us as we: (1 mark)
   A. Forgive others
   B. Forget others
   C. Punish others
   D. Ignore others

20. What does Matthew 5:39 teach? (1 mark)
   A. Hit back harder
   B. Ignore everyone
   C. Take what is yours
   D. Do not resist an evil person by taking revenge

21. What is a harambee? (1 mark)
   A. People pooling resources to help someone
   B. A school game
   C. A kind of fruit
   D. A holiday

22. Why should we help promptly? (1 mark)
   A. Delay is better
   B. Needs may be urgent
   C. Helping is a waste
   D. Nobody needs help

23. How many silver coins did the woman have? (1 mark)
   A. Ten
   B. Five
   C. Twelve
   D. Two

24. Which of these shows a good response to John 3:16? (1 mark)
   A. Blaming others
   B. Forgetting the verse
   C. Ignoring God
   D. Believing in Jesus and thanking God

25. Which of these is a trusted person at school? (1 mark)
   A. Your class teacher
   B. A person who offers gifts
   C. A stranger at the gate
   D. Someone who asks for secrets

26. Who was tempted by Potiphar's wife? (1 mark)
   A. Samson
   B. Daniel
   C. Joseph
   D. Abraham

27. What does integrity mean? (1 mark)
   A. Copying others
   B. Doing right when nobody is watching
   C. Being lucky
   D. Being popular

28. What does exaggeration mean? (1 mark)
   A. Making things sound bigger than they are
   B. Being kind
   C. Being silent
   D. Telling the exact truth

29. If you break a friend's ruler, what should you do? (1 mark)
   A. Say nothing
   B. Blame another
   C. Say sorry and offer to replace it
   D. Hide it

30. What does responsibility mean? (1 mark)
   A. Breaking things
   B. Doing your duties and caring for what belongs to you
   C. Leaving jobs to others
   D. Being lazy

31. Which is school property? (1 mark)
   A. Your shoes
   B. A pencil case
   C. Your lunch
   D. A desk

32. In 1 Corinthians 6:19, what does Paul call the body of a believer? (1 mark)
   A. Machines
   B. Property of strangers
   C. Temples of the Holy Spirit
   D. Toys

33. What should we do with phones in church? (1 mark)
   A. Make calls
   B. Watch videos
   C. Play games
   D. Switch them off or keep them silent

34. What does Psalm 122:1 say people were glad to do? (1 mark)
   A. Go to sleep
   B. Go to war
   C. Go to market
   D. Go to the house of the Lord

35. In which city were believers first called Christians? (1 mark)
   A. Jerusalem
   B. Nazareth
   C. Jericho
   D. Antioch

36. What does "Amen" mean? (1 mark)
   A. Let it be so
   B. Hello
   C. Thank you for food
   D. Goodbye

37. Which of these is a fruit of the Spirit? (1 mark)
   A. Jealousy
   B. Kindness
   C. Anger
   D. Greed

38. How many fruits of the Spirit are listed? (1 mark)
   A. Nine
   B. Seven
   C. Twelve
   D. Five

39. Which verses in Galatians speak of self-control? (1 mark)
   A. Galatians 5:22-25
   B. Genesis 1:1
   C. Acts 2:1
   D. Luke 1:37

40. Which decision step comes first? (1 mark)
   A. Ask nobody
   B. Choose quickly
   C. Copy others
   D. Stop and think

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
41. Give two reasons why we should not take revenge. (2 marks)

42. Explain why we should thank God for making us. (3 marks)

43. Why were people with leprosy kept apart in Bible times? (2 marks)

44. List three activities Christians do in church. (3 marks)

45. Explain four reasons why children should honour their parents. (5 marks)

46. Give two examples from the Bible of people who disobeyed God. (2 marks)

47. Explain how we can prevent the spread of contagious diseases and how we should treat those who are sick. (5 marks)

48. What does the name Nazirite refer to in the story of Samson? (2 marks)

49. Give two meanings of the word church. (2 marks)

50. Explain how Stephen's forgiving spirit is like that of Jesus and how a child can copy it. (5 marks)

51. State three qualities of Mary that a child can copy. (3 marks)

52. Give two ways of helping a needy classmate. (2 marks)

53. Describe how Mary responded to the angel's message. (3 marks)

54. Explain why young people should lead holy lives, and give four ways of doing it. (5 marks)

55. Name two fruits of the Spirit and give an example of each. (2 marks)

56. Name the four Gospels and say what they tell us about. (4 marks)

57. Explain how the story of Balaam teaches obedience to God and respect for those in authority. (5 marks)

58. Explain why Jesus cleared the temple. (3 marks)

59. Give two words that describe Joseph's character in this story. (2 marks)
pages.answers:
CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — PREMIUM REVISION PAPER #7 · MARKING SCHEME
====

SECTION A
----
1. D — Psalm 139
   Psalm 139:14 speaks of being fearfully and wonderfully made.

2. C — You can tell a helper who you are if you get lost
   A name helps people identify you and help you find your family.

3. A — I want to take what is not mine
   Wanting to take what belongs to others leads to stealing.

4. D — Joshua
   Joshua 24:15 records these words.

5. C — Admit it, say sorry and try to put it right
   Being honest about mistakes lets us make things right.

6. D — Respect and love among members
   Respect and love make a home peaceful.

7. C — Handling the Bible with care
   Care with God's word shows respect.

8. A — 66
   39 + 27 = 66.

9. A — Making things right with those we wronged
   Zacchaeus showed repentance by paying back.

10. A — To be sorry for sin and turn away from it
   Repentance includes turning away from wrong.

11. C — To respect and love Him and obey Him
   The fear of God is deep respect.

12. B — Seven years of famine
   The thin cows were seven years of famine.

13. C — Following good instructions even when it is hard
   Abraham obeyed God without knowing the whole plan.

14. D — Haran
   Terah's family settled in Haran.

15. C — Nazareth
   Luke 1:26 says Gabriel came to Nazareth in Galilee.

16. C — Repent
   John called people to turn from their sins.

17. C — A child who thanks her neighbour for a kind act
   Saying thank you shows gratitude.

18. A — The dead man sat up and began to talk
   Luke 7:15 says he sat up and began to talk.

19. A — Forgive others
   The prayer links our forgiveness with forgiving others.

20. D — Do not resist an evil person by taking revenge
   Jesus taught us to break the cycle of revenge.

21. A — People pooling resources to help someone
   Harambee means pulling together to help.

22. B — Needs may be urgent
   Quick help reduces suffering.

23. A — Ten
   She had ten silver coins.

24. D — Believing in Jesus and thanking God
   We respond with faith and thanks.

25. A — Your class teacher
   Teachers help keep children safe.

26. C — Joseph
   Genesis 39 tells the story of Joseph.

27. B — Doing right when nobody is watching
   Integrity is honesty in private.

28. A — Making things sound bigger than they are
   Exaggerating is not being truthful.

29. C — Say sorry and offer to replace it
   Honesty and repair are responsible.

30. B — Doing your duties and caring for what belongs to you
   Responsibility means doing what is expected.

31. D — A desk
   A desk belongs to the school.

32. C — Temples of the Holy Spirit
   The body is a temple.

33. D — Switch them off or keep them silent
   Phones can disturb worship.

34. D — Go to the house of the Lord
   The psalm rejoices at going to God's house.

35. D — Antioch
   Acts 11:26.

36. A — Let it be so
   Amen means so be it.

37. B — Kindness
   Kindness is listed.

38. A — Nine
   There are nine.

39. A — Galatians 5:22-25
   Galatians 5:22-25.

40. D — Stop and think
   Stopping helps you decide well.

SECTION B
----
41. (2 marks)
   Answer: It starts a cycle of hurt; it gets us in trouble; it breaks friendships; it displeases God.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each valid reason.

42. (3 marks)
   Answer: God created us in His image and planned each of us. He gave us life, family and talents. Thanking Him shows that we value His gifts.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for God creating us, 1 for the gifts of life or talents, 1 for the link to giving thanks.

43. (2 marks)
   Answer: The disease was contagious and people feared it would spread.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for disease and 1 for fear of spread.

44. (3 marks)
   Answer: Pray, sing, read the Bible, give offerings, listen to the sermon, fellowship.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each.

45. (5 marks)
   Answer: God commands it (Exodus 20:12); parents care for us; it brings peace at home; it brings God's blessing; it sets an example for younger children.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each valid reason up to 4, and 1 mark for a clear explanation.

46. (2 marks)
   Answer: Adam and Eve, Jonah.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each example.

47. (5 marks)
   Answer: Wash hands with soap, keep the environment clean, eat well, visit the clinic and follow the advice of health workers. We should treat the sick with care, kindness and respect and not reject them, as Jesus did.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for hygiene, 1 for clean environment, 1 for clinic advice, 1 for kindness, 1 for not rejecting the sick.

48. (2 marks)
   Answer: A person set apart for God from birth.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for set apart and 1 mark for for God.

49. (2 marks)
   Answer: The building where Christians worship; the community of believers.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each.

50. (5 marks)
   Answer: Jesus prayed, "Father, forgive them," on the cross. Stephen prayed that the sin would not be held against those who stoned him. A child can forgive those who mock or hurt them, pray for them and not take revenge.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for Jesus, 1 for Stephen, 1 for the similarity, 1 for forgiving, 1 for praying or not taking revenge.

51. (3 marks)
   Answer: Trust in God, obedience, humility, purity.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each quality.

52. (2 marks)
   Answer: Share a pencil or lunch, help with a lesson, welcome them.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each valid way.

53. (3 marks)
   Answer: She was troubled at first, asked how it could happen since she was a virgin, and then accepted, saying she was the Lord's servant.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for being troubled or asking, 1 for how, 1 for accepting.

54. (5 marks)
   Answer: God is holy and asks us to be holy. Our bodies are temples of the Holy Spirit. A holy life keeps us safe and pleases God. Ways: keep clean, avoid drugs and alcohol, choose good friends, avoid harmful media, pray and read the Bible.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for God's call, 1 for the temple idea, 1 for safety, 2 for ways.

55. (2 marks)
   Answer: Love: sharing lunch; kindness: helping a friend.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each fruit with example.

56. (4 marks)
   Answer: Matthew, Mark, Luke and John. They tell about the life, teachings, death and resurrection of Jesus.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each Gospel named up to 3 marks, and 1 mark for what they tell about.

57. (5 marks)
   Answer: God told Balaam what to say and do, and Balaam had to obey even though a king offered rewards. We should obey God's word and instructions from parents and teachers when they are good and right. Disobeying can put us in danger.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for God's instruction, 1 for the reward temptation, 1 for obedience to God, 1 for obeying parents and teachers, 1 for danger of disobedience.

58. (3 marks)
   Answer: The temple was meant for prayer but people used it to make money and cheat. Jesus cared for the honour of His Father's house.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for prayer purpose, 1 for making money or cheating, 1 for honour of God's house.

59. (2 marks)
   Answer: Wise, honest, humble, faithful, hardworking, trusting in God. Any two.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each valid word.
